description: Queensland Spatial Catalogue (QSpatial) is a database run by Queensland Government, Department of Resources. QSpatial is the state spatial catalogue with hundreds of layers on roads, rail, ports, water and energy assets and on flood, bushfire, storm-tide and landslide hazards, available as downloads and map services. Coverage: Queensland. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as shp, gdb, wms, wfs; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Queensland Spatial Catalogue : Queensland Government") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support infrastructure asset and hazard exposure studies of Queensland. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
